items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: I was with Happy Cook and Little Chink Martin

ctx.x: Well, you couldn't spend any money on the boat, huh, Much? No. Did you gamble? Oh, no. I never gambled. I would think that'd be one thing to do on the boats, river boats. That's traditional.

When I was playing with Tony Foucherat and Mutt Powers and Flavor Ford, like I told you, we were playing in Smack Over Arkansas at one time. No. Tony wasn't in that band. I was with Happy Cook and Little Chink Martin, Charlie DuPont, Harry Shields. When we were playing at a gambling place about five miles out of Smack Over Arkansas, when gambling was strictly against the law, on New Year's Eve night, I saw a man walk out after losing everything in the world he had.
